title: My Rival is the Umadol of the Sand.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... Aaand done. Hm, I'm getting through these exercises much faster than before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've been training together for some
time now, and Wonder Acute's
endurance
has indeed improved markedly.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And I know who I have to thank for that.
All I've done is train just like
you tell me
to, but I can already feel the difference.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Plus, you're always changing up the
routine, so I'm learning so many
new
things. If we keep this up, my 2,000-meter
dirt race should be no
problem.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's kind enough to hand me
compliments here and there, but I'm

frankly more impressed with her than she is
with me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every time I increased her training load,
she didn't so much as utter a
word of
complaint. Day in and day out she put in
the work, and it
shows.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she keeps this up, she'll be able to build
a solid track record once
she debuts.
Picturing that future renews my resolve to
train her as
best I can.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If you didn't tell me I had my very own
secret weapon, I never
would've known.
Just another thing I owe you for.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, sounds to me like you're cooking
up another new training
plan. I'll be
waiting! There's nothing you can give me
that I can't do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spend the rest of the morning on my new
training plan, then go
looking for Wonder
Acute. She's not in her classroom, so I step

outside and find...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're Acute's trainer, aren't you? If
you're looking for her, she's
right over
here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm motioned over to Wonder Acute and
her two friends, Hokko
Tarumae and
Copano Rickey, standing in a circle.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Acute, you really went and signed
on with a trainer?! If you've
found the yin
to your yang, count yourself very lucky
and happy! ☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, I'm afraid I haven't signed
anything just yet. I'm just borrowing
a
helping hand for the Tracen Meet.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Really? That's too bad. I mean, even I've
heard the rumors—a
promising new trainer
who graduated trainer school with top
honors in
seven subjects?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Is that right? I didn't know you were such a
distinguished trainer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're always so humble. You should
give yourself more credit,
you know.
Thanks to your help, I think I'll be able to
put up a good
fight at the Tracen Meet.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A good fight... I don't know. I mean,
considering who you're up
against...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wait, so you haven't heard? Acute's
2,000-meter dirt race is also
going to
have...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Woohoohooo! Falco, taking flight. Here I
gooo! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Dwah!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at her! This is incredible! It's
almost like she's drawing qi
straight from
the dragon veins into her legs!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Explosive acceleration, speed that picks
up even more at the end...
She's just
different—no one can outshine Falco on
the dirt.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: The field hasn't been announced yet, but I've heard she'll be running. Besting Falco on dirt would be nearly impossible for anyone right now.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Also, fire conquers metal. Our Acute here
may have a resolve of steel,
but Falco and
her fiery running will be a menace
according to feng
shui!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't get Smart Falcon's running out of
my mind. Don't get me wrong,
Wonder
Acute has shown great improvement, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Phew. I'm not done yet!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, remind me what I'm doing next?
...Oh? Trainer, dear?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is no time to be spacing out. I can't let
all her hard work go to
waste. There has to
be more I can do, but my mind is drawing
blanks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I mean, her opponent is not only
post-debut, she's one of the top
active
runners. The gap is undeniable.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Come on, Trainer, no need to be shy,
now.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I know full well I won't stand a chance at
this rate. So if I'm to put up a
fight against
Falco, you'll have to make me a tougher
routine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her current load is already the result of me
gradually upping the
intensity as she grew.
Any more than this would be unrealistic.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I know that, but I wonder if there isn't
something else I could be
doing. Like...
honing my body for the race, for example.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Let me tell you about the time I ran for
Tracen's entrance exams. The
nerves got
to me, and I showed up on the day
weighing a good bit
less than usual.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But somehow I felt better than ever, if you
can believe it. My legs felt
so free, like
they might carry me off to the ends of the
earth.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If I could hone my body like that again, I'd
have a puncher's
chance—I just know it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's true that cutting weight to maximize
performance is something you
see a lot.
All else equal, the lighter you are, the
faster you run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But that aside, I'm impressed at her
tenacity. Rather than let a
superior
opponent intimidate her, she's focused on
improving her
chances any way she can.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, I wouldn't say that. Who I'm up
against doesn't matter to me. It's
more
that...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A win in this race would mean an awful lot
to someone I know. So no
matter what, I
need to earn this win for that someone.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And that, Trainer, is why I need you to be
tougher on me. I trust you,
so you go on
and trust me to keep up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't know who this someone is, but
whatever her reasons may be, if
she wants
to win, then it's my job as a trainer to
make it happen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, I set my mind to preparing a
weight-cutting routine for
Wonder Acute.
